name: standard
summary: Movement formations and techniques after US Army practice: wedge to move into possible contact, bound when contact is likely, herringbone at a halt. See _agents/doctrine.md.

movement.why: halted in cover: herringbone, alternate flanks watched
halted in the open: coil, all-round security
screening: a line watches the widest frontage
support by fire: every gun on the objective, nobody advancing
in contact: get every gun into the fight
contact likely in close country: column through the lanes, bounding, one element always covering
contact likely: bound forward, one element always overwatching the other
scouts forward in a V: two sets of eyes up front, the leader behind them
artillery and lasers move in column behind the guns
contact possible: wedge, fire to the front and both flanks covered, trail element overwatching
nothing out there and tight lanes: column is the fastest shape to control
open ground, nothing in sight: wedge, and keep moving
